# Kromaloom

> Website redesign studio for small businesses in Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom and the UAE. We turn dated websites into fast, mobile-first sites with search basics built in, and keep existing Google rankings by redirecting old pages. Every prospect gets a free redesign concept of their homepage within 24 hours, before paying anything.

## Redesign packages (founding prices)
- Redesign, up to 5 pages: CA$299 / US$249 / £199 / AED 899, live in 24 hours
- Redesign Plus, up to 10 pages with copy, speed and local search fixes: CA$499 / US$399 / £299 / AED 1,499, live in 48 hours
- Store redesign, Shopify or WooCommerce, up to 50 products: CA$899 / US$749 / £549 / AED 2,699, live in 3 to 5 days
- Care plans after launch from CA$29 per month
- Second-language versions (Arabic, French) at +50% of the package

## Terms
- No upfront payment: built on a private preview link, paid after approval, then launched
- Client owns domain, hosting and all files
